import re
import sys

text = open("docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
heads = [(m.start(), m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r"^### (DEC-\d+)\b", text, re.M)]
want = set(sys.argv[1:])
limit = 2500
for i, (pos, dec) in enumerate(heads):
    if dec in want:
        end = heads[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(heads) else len(text)
        body = text[pos:end]
        cut = body.find("| Version |")
        if cut > 0:
            body = body[:cut]
        print(body[:limit])
        print("-----")
